name: pac
description: PAC helps students stay organized, understand their course materials and progress in their studies, with study support based on their own university coursework.

interface.longDescription: PAC helps university students stay organized, understand their course materials and progress in their studies. Connect your PAC account to ChatGPT to get study support based on your own coursework. Check what is due and when so you can plan your work, ask questions about the course materials synced to PAC and get answers based on what is in them, and look through your courses, assignments, announcements and grades to see how you are progressing. If you ask, it can also add a personal assignment to one of your courses to help you keep track of your work. You need a PAC account with your university connected in PAC. It only uses your own account's data and never shows other students' information. Answers come from PAC's study assistant and are shown in your ChatGPT conversation.
defaultPrompt: What assignments are due this week?
Summarize my courses and upcoming deadlines
